propositions: When file_impact is undeclared, currency falls back to invalidating on any code-SHA change, causing false-positive re-reviews (21% of cases on byte-identical material).
The read-set (file paths actually fetched during LLM review) must be recorded in the signed manifest, normalized (tool-filtered, root-resolved, repo-relative, deduplicated), and verified before use.

Scoping the fail-safe applies only when pre-existing dependency set is empty, container poison rule is inactive, scope is undeclared, and a read-set was recorded; drift invalidation then checks read-set plus blast-radius entries (criteria config, rebar.toml, rubrics, workflow gates).
A glob pattern in the dependency set is handled via membership digest (sha256 of sorted matched files) to detect file additions/deletions, while plain paths use content hash.
Unverifiable read-set, pre-change attestations without the field, and expansion failure each fall back to invalidate-on-any-change (fail-safe).
The signed manifest records an authenticated currency-basis line (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) enabling status reporting without re-computation.
